seoTitle: View Multiple Charts on TradingView (Free or Paid)
metaDescription: Learn how to set up 2, 3, or 4 charts at once on TradingView across PC and mobile, and what's possible on the free plan versus paid plans.
intro: Watching multiple markets at once is easier with a multi-chart layout on TradingView, whether you're comparing 2, 3, or 4 symbols side by side. This guide covers setting up a multi-chart layout on both PC and mobile, and what's available depending on your plan.

steps.heading: Open the layout selector
steps.body: From the chart toolbar, find the layout options that let you choose how many charts to display at once.

steps.heading: Choose your grid size
steps.body: Select a 2, 3, or 4-chart layout depending on how many symbols you want to monitor simultaneously.

steps.heading: Assign a symbol to each chart
steps.body: Click into each individual chart panel and set the symbol you want displayed there.

steps.heading: Check plan limitations
steps.body: Free accounts may have fewer multi-chart options than paid plans, so check what's available for your current subscription.

steps.heading: Set it up on mobile
steps.body: The TradingView mobile app supports similar multi-chart layouts, though the exact controls differ slightly from the desktop version.

steps.heading: Save your layout
steps.body: Once your multi-chart setup is arranged the way you like, save it so you can return to the same view later.

faq.question: Can I view multiple charts for free on TradingView?
faq.answer: Free accounts have some multi-chart capability, though paid plans typically unlock more simultaneous charts and layout options.

faq.question: How many charts can I view at once?
faq.answer: Depending on your plan, you can view layouts such as 2, 3, or 4 charts at the same time.

faq.question: Does the multi-chart layout work on mobile?
faq.answer: Yes, the TradingView mobile app supports multi-chart layouts, though the setup process differs slightly from desktop.

faq.question: Can I save a multi-chart layout for later?
faq.answer: Yes, once arranged, you can save the layout so you can return to the same setup in future sessions.

faq.question: Why use multiple charts at once?
faq.answer: It lets you monitor several symbols or timeframes side by side, which is useful for comparing markets in real time.
